channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michael Malone | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michael Malone from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jamal Murray on Michael Malone
item.description:
Bennett Durando:Jamal Murray:

“Shoutout to Coach Malone. I think he’ll be great. I think he’ll be a great college coach. I think his daughter is there as well. So I think it’s a win-win for him, and I think he’ll enjoy his next chapter of his coaching career.”

Jamal Murray on Michael Malone, Apr 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Michael Malone
item.description:
Tyronn Lue on Michael Malone:

“It's too close to try to pick somebody's brain when they just got fired, just won a championship two years ago. I wouldn't do that. No, out of respect for him, I wouldn't do that.”

Tyronn Lue on Michael Malone, Apr 15, 2025. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Josh Kroenke on Michael Malone, Calvin Booth
item.description:
Bennett Durando:Josh Kroenke:

“I saw it was reported that I would sit in with meetings with Calvin (Booth) and Coach (Malone) at times, which I did. We had great conversations in those meetings. But I need more when I'm not around. My role is not to necessarily be there on a daily basis.”

Josh Kroenke on Michael Malone, Calvin Booth, Apr 14, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Josh Kroenke on Michael Malone, Calvin Booth
item.description:
Josh Kroenke on firing Michael Malone and Calvin Booth:

“To be frank, neither of them deserved it. And for that, I apologize... Ineeded to be better (too)...ultimately, I made the decision last week with the hope of trying to rejuvenate the group.”

Josh Kroenke on Michael Malone, Calvin Booth, Apr 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Josh Kroenke, Michael Malone, Calvin Booth
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on the Nuggets firing Michael Malone and Calvin Booth:

“Iknew a little bit before everybody. And (Josh Kroenke) told me, ‘We made a decision.’ So it was not a discussion. It was a decision, and he told me why. So I listened and I accept it.”

Nikola Jokic on Josh Kroenke, Michael Malone, Calvin Booth, Apr 10, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Michael Malone
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Michael Malone's firing:

“I wake up every day saying this could be my last day.”

Joe Mazzulla on Michael Malone, Apr 9, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Michael Malone
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on mentor Michael Malone's firing:

“It's not a great day. It's part of this business but definitely not (good). Shocking. W/ the championship coach he is, for sure he'll be back coaching in this league very soon. But not something you want to hear for sure.”

Jordi Fernandez on Michael Malone, Apr 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Josh Kroenke on Michael Malone
item.description:
Denver Nuggets owner Josh Kroenke:

“While the timing of this decision is unfortunate, as Coach Michael Malone helped build the foundation of our now championship level program, it is a necessary step to allow us to compete at the highest level right now. Championship level standards and expectations remain in place for the current season, and as we look to the future, we look forward to building on the foundations laid by Coach Malone over his record-breaking 10-year career in Denver.”

Josh Kroenke on Michael Malone, Apr 8, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mike Brown, Michael Malone, Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Rick Carlisle on Michael Malone, Mike Brown and Taylor Jenkins getting fired this season:

“If anyone would've told me any of these guys would've been fired midseason, I would've been shocked. ... It's disappointing,it's kinda numbing to be honest.”

Rick Carlisle on Mike Brown, Michael Malone, Taylor Jenkins, Apr 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Malik Beasley on Michael Malone
item.description:
Malik Beasley:

“Favorite coach other than the one I’m playing for right now? Yeah, I would say Michael Malone. He was hard on me.”

Malik Beasley on Michael Malone, Feb 21, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Malik Beasley on Michael Malone
item.description:
Malik Beasley:

“Yeah, Nuggets coach. So, uh, he was hard on me, but he was a great coach. You saw what he did—he won the championship. So, shoutout to Mike Malone, man. My second favorite coach.”

Malik Beasley on Michael Malone, Feb 21, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Michael Malone, Mike Brown
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff on Mike Brown’s firing:

“Mike is one of these most classy guys we have in our profession. He’s one of the best people that I know. I’ll echo Mike Malone’s comments — the way it was handled was classless … the way you treat human beings matters.”

JB Bickerstaff on Michael Malone, Mike Brown, Dec 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Michael Malone
item.description:
Monty Williams on what Mike Malone has built in Denver:

“It’s the model for what I think NBA organizations should strive for…Idon’t think I would’ve had a clue as to what an NBA season was supposed to look like from a head coach perspective (without Malone).”

Monty Williams on Michael Malone, Jan 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Ishmael Smith on Michael Malone, Calvin Booth
item.description:
“Start transitioning to some front office. Some coaching. Who knows? I didn’t know, but I was just going. … I was gonna watch Calvin (general manager Calvin Booth), and then watch Coach (Michael Malone). Try to help out as much as possible. I just wanted to learn to see what I wanted to do.”

Ishmael Smith on Michael Malone, Calvin Booth, Jan 2, 2024. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Calvin Booth on Michael Malone
item.description:
“But I think it’s just another option, another tool in the toolkit for Coach (Michael) Malone,”

Calvin Booth on Michael Malone, Jun 26, 2023. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Christian Braun on Bill Self, Michael Malone
item.description:
Michael Singer:Christian Braun, on the comparisons between Michael Malone and Bill Self:

“Those are two of the most competitive people I’ve been around since I’ve been playing basketball.”

Christian Braun on Bill Self, Michael Malone, May 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Michael Malone
item.description:
“Great continuity. Been together for what? How long Mike Malone been there, six years?”

Kevin Durant on Michael Malone, May 12, 2023. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Michael Malone
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Aaron Gordon on Michael Malone not putting him back in the game late in the 4th quarter against Philly:

“I think he understood what the situation was and what it called for. I think he actually made the right call.”

Aaron Gordon on Michael Malone, Mar 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Michael Porter
item.description:
“I’m here to win a championship for Joker (Nikola Jokic).Joker’s here to win a championship for Jamal (Murray) and Michael Malone and Michael Porter. KCP, we’re looking to get him another one. I’m not doing this for myself. I’m doing it for the guys around me.”

Aaron Gordon on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Michael Porter, Mar 8, 2023. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Calvin Booth on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Michael Porter
item.description:
“But on the other side, what’s really easy is I know what Coach Malone likes. I have a feeling or a vision for the kind of guys, Nikola, Jamal or Michael would like to play with, and it just happens to be in line with my philosophy anyway.”

Calvin Booth on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Michael Porter, Jul 13, 2022. Source: DNVR.

item.title: Calvin Booth on Michael Malone
item.description:
“The hard part about where I’m at right now is we’ve done a great job. Tim and Coach Malone and Mr. K and Josh, all of our best players getting us to this point, andnow you’re inside the 10-yard line and the job becomes really, really hard,”

Calvin Booth on Michael Malone, Jul 13, 2022. Source: DNVR.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Michael Malone
item.description:
“I was given the opportunity. I'm thankful for Mike Malone. I spoke with him before. A lot of doors closed for me. Mike looked out, gave me an opportunity. I just tried to take the best advantage of it as I could. That's what I did.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Michael Malone, Apr 28, 2022. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Michael Malone
item.description:
In 2017, with Malone serving a suspension, Unseld stepped up to coach the Nuggets on the road in Sacramento.

“[Malone] and I sat in the hotel lobby because I don’t think we could even get the game in our hotel rooms and we sat in a lobby in Sacramento and watched the game,”

Tim Connelly on Michael Malone, Jul 18, 2021. Source: NBC Washington DC.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Michael Malone
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic on Malone endorsing him for MVP:

“It's nice. The guys are trusting me. The coaches are trusting me. The front office is trusting me. The Kroenke family (is trusting me). It's really nice to have such a big group of people behind you, trusting you.”

Nikola Jokic on Michael Malone, Mar 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Michael Malone
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Thibodeau on Michael Malone:

“The job that he's done in Denver has been amazing...to take Denver from where it was to where it is now, he deserves a lot of credit for that. He's still young. That's the amazing thing. But he's had a great career.”

Tom Thibodeau on Michael Malone, Jan 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Zeke Nnaji on Michael Malone
item.description:
Michael Singer:Zeke Nnaji on today’s practice:

“We can’t take days for granted. That’s the biggest thing. (Malone) just wants to make sure we’re on top of it,that we’re using our time wisely.”

Zeke Nnaji on Michael Malone, Dec 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: LeBron James on Michael Malone
item.description:
Harrison Wind:LeBron James on his relationship with Michael Malone, who was an assistant in Cleveland for five season when James was there:

“When you work hard on your craft and you see others working just as hard on their craft, it becomes organic and mutual respect...”

LeBron James on Michael Malone, Sep 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Bol Bol on Michael Malone
item.description:
He then raved about Bol:

“This kid right here has it. And I’m glad he’s with a guy like Mike Malone because Mike speaks our language.”

Bol Bol on Michael Malone, Jul 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Michael Malone
item.description:
“We have been very fortunate to have Coach Malone lead our resurgence. His tireless work ethic and passion are clearly reflected in the continued improvement of our roster,”

Tim Connelly on Michael Malone, Dec 24, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Michael Malone
item.description:
“Obviously I wanted to play and I thought I could've contributed in the regular season and playoffs, but I understood (coach Michael Malone's) decision and I think I contributed in other ways as a leader, as someone who was there to answer the questions of the younger guys. I stayed ready and prepared to play.”

Isaiah Thomas on Michael Malone, Jun 26, 2019. Source: ESPN.
